'''[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Harrum''' was a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], he believed that the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] was hiring mercenaries to fight their illegal battles on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. He tasked a Republic spacer to search the Imperial mercenary camp and find proof that the Empire hired them for these illegal raids.
